content.study:
Section 31A — Regime for costs

Section 31A establishes the statutory regime for costs in arbitral proceedings and related proceedings. The tribunal or Court, as applicable under the section, determines costs subject to the statutory principles, including the general rule concerning the unsuccessful party and the factors expressly recognised by the provision.

Apply the statutory conditions and procedural consequences on the proved record.
